title: cleanup: run isort and add to tox linter check
description:
Changes:
* Updated `tox -e lint` to run isort
* Updated isort settings to use the "black" profile
* Ran isort
patch_diff:
diff --git a/pyproject.toml b/pyproject.toml
index 468c7b93..21f1a41a 100644
--- a/pyproject.toml
+++ b/pyproject.toml
@@ -2,10 +2,7 @@
 line-length = 79
 
 [tool.isort]
-multi_line_output = 3
-include_trailing_comma = true
-force_grid_wrap = 0
-use_parentheses = true
+profile = "black"
 line_length = 79
 known_first_party = ["cattr"]
